text:
The ordering constraints force two chains:

- Ivo before Ann before Elif before Gus before Hana
- Finn before Ben before Dev, with Cara immediately after Dev

Cara and Elif have exactly one slot between them, so their positions differ by 2. Dev is at least slot 3 (Finn and Ben sit earlier), and Elif needs two slots after her, so the only pair of positions that still leaves room for both chains is Elif in 5, Dev in 6, Cara in 7, Gus in 8, Hana in 9. The first four slots are then exactly Ivo, Finn, Ann, and Ben. The remaining separation constraints force Finn in 2 (so Elif is three slots away) and {Ivo, Ben} = {1, 4}; Finn-before-Ben then puts Ivo in 1, Ann in 3, and Ben in 4. Every other placement of the Dev–Cara block contradicts at least one ordering or separation constraint.
